scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible finite checks; competing 2025 nullcline coefficient 27 acknowledged as prior knowledge; an earlier relevant full paper remains inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Scalar prey with logistic growth and fixed externally controlled Holling-III predator pressure; finite prescribed blocks and endpoint objective only. Local reversal above the threshold is proved for short equal durations, not arbitrary finite durations. No field applicability or independent validation established.
title: A sharp carrying-capacity threshold for ordering Holling-III predator treatments
